verified_hardware_behavior.iop_services: Passed; embedded modules loaded, IOPCD bound
verified_hardware_behavior.graphics_synthesizer: Passed; GS output active, rendered IGR overlay menu
verified_hardware_behavior.igr_combo_detection: Passed; detected 6-button combo and triggered IGR sequence

interpretation: Sony POPS executed successfully on physical PlayStation 2 hardware from launcHER. The bootstrap gate is cleared. Subsystem execution reached active controller polling and GS rendering. Next phase investigates disc sector streaming (TOC read and game startup) and clean IGR exit handling.
